name: Plaza at Cedar Hill
summary: Plaza at Cedar Hill is a community shopping center in Cedar Hill, Texas, managed by Kite Realty Group. Conveniently located along FM 1382, it serves the southern Dallas-Fort Worth area with a practical mix of retail and dining options for everyday needs.
demographics: Plaza at Cedar Hill serves a diverse suburban community in the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex, attracting middle-income families and working professionals from Cedar Hill and surrounding areas. The trade area consists primarily of households with median incomes ranging from $50,000 to $85,000, with a strong representation of families with children and young adults aged 25-54. Shoppers typically visit for convenient access to everyday necessities, value-oriented retail options, and family-friendly dining experiences that cater to the practical needs of suburban residents.
description: Plaza at Cedar Hill is a well-established community shopping center located along Farm to Market Road 1382 in Cedar Hill, Texas, serving the southern Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex. Managed by Kite Realty Group, a prominent national real estate investment trust specializing in retail properties, this center has become a convenient shopping destination for local residents seeking everyday goods and services. The plaza's strategic location in Cedar Hill provides easy accessibility for families and professionals throughout the area, offering a practical mix of retail, dining, and service-oriented tenants. With operating hours from 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM daily, the center accommodates the busy schedules of working families and provides a comfortable shopping environment. As part of Kite Realty's extensive portfolio of community-focused properties across the United States, Plaza at Cedar Hill reflects the company's commitment to property management excellence and tenant satisfaction, maintaining a solid 4.3-star rating from nearly 4,000 customer reviews.
